description: This file defines a React Native component 'LudoBoard' which renders a visual representation of a Ludo game board, including tokens, safe zones, entry points, and interactive elements for gameplay. It manages animations for token movements and highlights selectable tokens.

methods.name: cellKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a cell based on its row and column indices.

methods.name: mixAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex or rgb color string into an rgba string with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: useTokenAnimMap
methods.description: Custom React hook that maintains a map of animated values for token positions and pulsing effects.
